## Description
Crash on an Android 4.4.2 device when checking CheckBox. Reproducible on an emulator (android-19 | Google APIs Intel x86 Atom).

## Reproducible Demo
https://github.com/guliash/rn-check-box-crash-demo
Just check the CheckBox.
